brief: Holds the house rules of the library that a code graph can check, as one graph rule set in the code domain.
detail: Five rules are loaded: no-len-method, no-aggressive-verbs, engine-first, q-has-plain-twin and no-case-collision. The sixth house rule, q-returns-object, needs a model of return statements that the code graph does not have, so StzCheckCode runs it as a text pass and merges the findings. The project set adds no-dead-code, and the deep set adds the slow no-cyclic-calls.
